extraction.notes: No camper-specific 2027 dates, prices or registration milestones were found. The volunteers page posts 2027 service-session dates, but these are not youth camper sessions and were not copied onto the camp card. Its adult guest and physician week dates also were not treated as camper dates. Registration is handled by local Young Life areas, not directly by Windy Gap. Carolina Point is a separate Young Life property and is not included under this provider.
